nodes.name: Read Lane
nodes.notes: ADR-066 chat Stage A: read config.agent_lane to gate the global-rules fold (managed has them cached in the agent system; bare folds them per-run). Fail-safe: onError continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so an unreadable flag defaults to bare/full and never starves the run.

parameters.query: select value as agent_lane from public.config where key = 'agent_lane' limit 1;

nodes.name: Parse Surface Ref
nodes.notes: ADR-066: the ingress passes surface_ref to the spine as a JSON STRING (convertFieldsToString). Parse it to {channel_id, message_id} for the chat reads. Defensive: accept an already-parsed object too.

nodes.name: Load Agent Rules
nodes.notes: Same global+personal rules Doc the task Stage A loads (workspace 761759 doc q7wz-16892, content text/md). onError continueRegularOutput + retry so a ClickUp blip degrades to no-rules (Build Chat Prompt WARNs), never throws.

nodes.name: Fetch Members
nodes.notes: Resolve the caller's display name (for the personal-rules page lookup, keyed by 'Instrukcje dla agenta - <name>') and thread author names. Chat messages expose only user_id. onError continueRegularOutput + retry so a blip degrades to no name resolution (personal rules treated missing), never throws.

nodes.name: Fetch Thread Replies
nodes.notes: Fetch the thread replies under the triggering message (bot token). The root message text arrives as triggering_comment_text from the producer; these are the follow-ups. onError continueRegularOutput + retry so an empty/failed fetch just yields no thread context.

nodes.name: Build Chat Prompt
nodes.notes: ADR-066 chat Stage A floor: global rules (bare lane only — managed has them cached in the agent system), caller personal rules, the triggering chat message, and the thread replies. Returns the SAME contract shape Build Prompt (task Stage A) returns so the orchestrator's downstream (Context OK? -> lane -> Execute Agent Session -> Render -> Post Reply) works unchanged. clickup_task_id='' (no task); image_blocks_json='[]' (chat is text-only in Block 2). Anything beyond the floor the agent pulls via its in-harness scoped ClickUp MCP (the Doc-via-Chat path).

nodes.name: Rules Health?
nodes.notes: Silent-degradation guard: WARN if global rules are missing where required (bare lane) or the triggering message text is empty (producer/ingress mapping broke). person_rules_missing alone is NOT alerted for chat (common: a user without a personal page).

value.message: Degradacja budowania kontekstu czatu: brak zasad ogólnych (bare) lub pusta treść wiadomości wywołującej.
value.details: =channel={{ $('Parse Surface Ref').first().json.channel_id }}; message={{ $('Parse Surface Ref').first().json.message_id }}; global_rules_missing={{ $json.global_rules_missing }}; person_rules_missing={{ $json.person_rules_missing }}

nodes.name: Return Context
nodes.notes: Single linear terminal (branch-free return) so the sub-workflow deterministically returns the chat context contract.
